connector.name: Dbt
connector.registryDescription: dbt MCP - manifest/run_results/sources/catalog parsing + DQ result tables (BigQuery/Postgres)
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package dbt-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the us-all account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: DBT_PROJECT_DIR
env.description: Path to dbt project root (where dbt_project.yml lives).

env.name: DBT_TARGET_DIR
env.description: dbt target dir for manifest.json/run_results.json (default: $DBT_PROJECT_DIR/target).

env.name: DBT_RUN_HISTORY_DIR
env.description: Optional dir for archived run_results.json history (glob-scanned).

env.name: DQ_BACKEND
env.description: DQ result table backend: 'bigquery' (default) or 'postgres'.

env.name: DQ_RESULTS_TABLE
env.description: Fully qualified DQ checks table, e.g. 'project.data_ops.quality_checks'.

env.name: DQ_SCORE_TABLE
env.description: Fully qualified DQ score-daily table, e.g. 'project.data_ops.quality_score_daily'.

env.name: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
env.description: Service account key path for BigQuery (ADC fallback supported).

env.name: BQ_PROJECT_ID
env.description: Explicit BigQuery project ID for DQ queries.

env.name: PG_CONNECTION_STRING
env.description: Postgres connection string when DQ_BACKEND=postgres.

env.name: DBT_ALLOW_WRITE
env.description: Reserved for future write tools. Default read-only.

env.name: DQ_SCHEMA
env.description: DQ result-table schema preset: 'generic' (default) or 'us-all'. Use DQ_COL_* env vars to override individual columns on top of the preset.

env.name: DQ_COL_RUN_AT
env.description: Override for the timestamp/date column on the DQ checks table. Default depends on DQ_SCHEMA preset.

env.name: DQ_COL_CHECK_TYPE
env.description: Override for the check-type column on the DQ checks table. Default 'check_type'.

env.name: DQ_COL_STATUS
env.description: Override for the status column on the DQ checks table. Default 'status'.

env.name: DQ_COL_DATASET
env.description: Override for the dataset/source column on the DQ checks table. Default depends on preset.

env.name: DQ_COL_TABLE_NAME
env.description: Override for the table/target-name column on the DQ checks table. Default depends on preset.

env.name: DQ_COL_SEVERITY
env.description: Override for the severity/dimension column on the DQ checks table. Default depends on preset.

env.name: DQ_COL_FAILURE_COUNT
env.description: Override for the numeric failure-count column on the DQ checks table. Default depends on preset.

env.name: DQ_COL_MESSAGE
env.description: Override for the message column on the DQ checks table. Default depends on preset.

env.name: DQ_COL_CHECK_NAME
env.description: Override for the check_name column on the DQ checks table. Set to 'none'/'null'/'-' to synthesize check_name from check_type and table_name.

env.name: DQ_COL_SCORE_DATE
env.description: Override for the date column on the DQ score-daily table. Default depends on preset.

env.name: DQ_COL_SCOPE
env.description: Override for the scope column on the DQ score-daily table. Set to 'none'/'null'/'-' if the table has no per-scope rollup.

env.name: DQ_COL_TIER
env.description: Override for the tier column on the DQ score-daily table. Set to 'none'/'null'/'-' if the table has no tier dimension.

env.name: DQ_TIER1_TARGET_PCT
env.description: When no tier column is configured (us-all preset or DQ_COL_TIER=none), the overall_score threshold dq-tier-status compares against (default 99.5). Superseded by DBT_SLA_CONFIG_PATH tier_sla.1 if both are set.

env.name: DBT_SLA_CONFIG_PATH
env.description: Optional path to a YAML file that defines tier_sla (per-tier overall_score targets) and dbt_sla (test/freshness pass rates). When set, dq-tier-status and dq-tier-by-source read tier targets from this file, and dbt-sla-status compares run_results / sources pass rates against dbt_sla.test_pass_pct / freshness_pass_pct. Mtime cached.

env.name: DBT_TOOLS
env.description: Comma-separated category allowlist (dbt,quality,meta).

env.name: DBT_DISABLE
env.description: Comma-separated category disablelist.
